items.title: Australia to introduce mandatory reporting after OpenAI hack to combat artificial intelligence ‘going rogue’

items.lede: AI safety regulator will also be created after a rogue OpenAI agent hacked government websites.
items.title: Australia considers criminal penalties for rogue AI in wake of OpenAI hack

items.lede: Australia's prime minister said its government would set up a new AI safety regulator and Labor would consider six key obligations on AI companies. The review made 18 recommendations. Anthony Albanese said: 'We accept all of the recommendations, and we’ve commenced work to implement them.'
